description.value: Founded in Kitsilano in 1968, The Naam is Vancouver's oldest natural foods restaurant and a long-standing neighbourhood institution on West 4th Avenue. It is a fully vegetarian, family-run restaurant that uses organic, locally-sourced ingredients including house-made tofu and tempeh, and locally-sourced vegan beer and wine. The relaxed, homey atmosphere and central Kitsilano location make it a welcoming stop for cyclists passing through the area.
